friendly_name: Migrate Felix Touchpoints to Sync Cache
source_description: Implements GitHub issue #519 (sub-issue of Epic #507). Migrates the 18 Felix Vikunja-touching read callsites enumerated in #518's RQ-2 research from direct Vikunja HTTP reads to reads from the sync driver's TaskCacheRecord cache. Adds shared helper scripts/common/sync_cache.py. Discovery decision Q1 (2026-06-04): clean cutover — old direct-read code is removed in the same change that adds the cache read; no fallback path; no runtime flag. Failure modes (cache missing, stale-beyond-SLA, task not in cache) surface as structured stderr+exit-nonzero errors per #518's no-silent-fallback rule. Out of scope: project-layer touchpoints (#520), changing what touchpoints semantically do, adding new touchpoints, modifying the driver itself, write touchpoints (continue to write directly to Vikunja).
